full_query: Do fissures and hemmroids heal on their own?

shared_context.topic: whether fissures and hemorrhoids heal on their own

sentences: Fissures and hemorrhoids can sometimes heal on their own, but this depends on several factors, including the severity and duration of the condition
Acute anal fissures often heal on their own with conservative management, such as increased dietary fiber, adequate hydration, and sitz baths

Chronic anal fissures, which persist for more than 6 weeks, may require medical treatment, including topical medications like nitroglycerin ointment or calcium channel blockers, and in some cases, surgical intervention

Mild hemorrhoids, particularly those that are external, can resolve on their own with conservative measures such as dietary changes, increased fluid intake, and over-the-counter treatments like topical creams and sitz baths
More severe hemorrhoids, especially those that are prolapsed or thrombosed, may require medical procedures such as rubber band ligation, sclerotherapy, or surgical removal
